title: Operational Risk Manager
summary: Operational risk managers run the operational risk framework for a bank, NBFC, insurer or fintech. They lead RCSAs, own loss data and key risk indicators, review new products and outsourcing for risk, oversee operational resilience, and report to senior management and the risk management committee.
dailyDuties: Lead RCSAs and review risk and control ratings
Review large loss events and drive root-cause fixes
Set and monitor KRIs against risk appetite
Review new products, processes and outsourcing for risk
Oversee resilience testing for critical operations
Present operational risk to the risk management committee

skills.expectation: Own the RCSA, loss data and KRI framework for a business or country
Tie operational risk to the firm's risk appetite and limits
Apply RBI guidance on operational risk and operational resilience
Oversee resilience of critical operations and continuity testing
Review control testing and assurance results
Report operational risk to the risk management committee
Lead a team of operational risk analysts
Challenge business heads on risk and remediation
Lead deep dives on large losses
Work with fraud risk on loss events
Build risk dashboards for senior management
